arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date) ORDER BY month
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions in each month of 2019, listed in month order from January to October.
assumptions: Year 2019 is taken as the whole calendar year; the data only covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so November and December are absent and the months shown are January through October.
All transactions are counted, labelled or not, including negative-amount rows.
